versions.changelog:
tiktok-skill v1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Provides keyword-based TikTok video search with sorting and time filter.
- Fetches public post lists for a TikTok creator by username or profile link, with newest/hottest sorting.
- Analyzes TikTok video comments by video link or ID, returning comment text, users, and interaction data.
- Read-only; requires only public data and outputs structured JSON.
- Requires a GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN environment variable for API access.
